# Handoff: 2026-10-28 planning session

Temporary context from a session run in the Wharf repository. Delete or
replace this file once the open items are resolved or moved to issues.

## What happened

* The Wharf knowledge pack and the draft TTT facilitator plan moved from
  Wharf to `docs/` here. Evidence links are pinned to Wharf commit `fd9c194`.
  Wharf keeps its retro, tracking evidence, benchmark data, and
  `docs/published-benchmarks.md`.
* The README references HVE Core and context-first instead of copying them.
  A full context-first import was built, then reverted at the user's request.
* `dev` was fast-forwarded to `main` and now has the README change (`17079d4`).

## Agreed TTT direction

* First session: start from a blank repository, install the skills, brainstorm
  an aka.ms-style URL shortener, produce the BRD, PRD, and JSONL requirements
  ledger, and create a specification template. Templates from the spec seed
  implementation, and implementation templates seed operations.
* Helium (movies) is a brownfield second lab for implementation and operations,
  because its spec and data already exist. Bring-your-own scenario comes after
  a known exercise.
* GitHub templates copy files but not history, so keep reference templates as
  facilitator fallbacks.

## Related benchmark plans (owned by Wharf)

FE uses Wharf for daily HydraFusion enterprise runs and weekly Opus and OpenAI
runs, to be charted on fe-labs.ai. The views are score, agent time, and cost,
with `score = PASS@1 - p2p_errors * 0.0025`. The methodology is in Wharf's
`docs/published-benchmarks.md`.
